description: MCP bridge and onboarding CLI that connects AI clients to 2,000+ AI models and APIs with OAuth, diagnostics, ownership-aware configuration updates, and exact rollback.

notes: The connect command completes browser authorization before installing the local bridge and client configuration.
Credentials are stored locally with restricted file permissions and are not passed in command-line arguments or URLs.
The v0.1.14 release passed the repository CI, package audit, and 150 automated tests before publication.
